---
title: "Outputs: events, QC, activity, covariates, weather, anonymized plots"
format: html
---

## How this file is organized

This file **builds on data.qmd and does not change it**.


## 0. Setup

This copies the cleaning from data.qmd so the numbers match. The one change is that the lists `unhelpful`
and `domestics` are defined **before** they are used (in data.qmd they come after, which breaks a fresh run).

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

event_gap_min        <- 30     # minutes between detections of the same species at the same camera = new event
min_trap_days        <- 60     # sites below this are FLAGGED, not removed
max_unid_share       <- 0.10   # sites above this share of unidentified tags are FLAGGED
min_events_activity  <- 30     # species with fewer events are left out of activity plots
project_start        <- ymd("2025-05-01")
export_date          <- ymd("2026-10-05")

report_dir <- "UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_2026-10-05_Reports"
report_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(report_dir,
            paste0("UWIN_Penn_Vet_UWIN_Penn_Vet_Accessing_Nature_May_2025_-_present_", name, ".csv"))
}
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

unhelpful <- c("STAFF/SETUP", "NONE", "Vehicle", "Unidentified")
domestics <- c("Human", "Domestic Dog", "Domestic Cat (House Cat)")

# cleaning
locations <- read.csv(report_file("location_report")) |>
  mutate(longitude = -abs(longitude)) |>   
  mutate(latitude  =  abs(latitude))

main_all <- read.csv(report_file("main_report")) |>      
  mutate(longitude = -abs(longitude)) |>
  mutate(latitude  =  abs(latitude)) |>
  mutate(superlocation = str_extract(location, "[:alpha:]*")) |>
  
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(image_date_time, tz = "UTC"))

main <- main_all |>                                       
  filter(!(species_common_name %in% unhelpful)) |>
  filter(!(species_common_name %in% domestics)) |>
  filter(!(species_scientific_name == ""))

sets <- read.csv(report_file("image_set_report")) |>
  mutate(start = ymd_hms(trimws(image_set_start_date_time), tz = "UTC"),
         end   = ymd_hms(trimws(image_set_end_date_time),   tz = "UTC"))
sets_complete <- sets |> filter(image_set_status == "Tagging Complete")

# wildlife rows that belong to finished sets only (sets still "Ready for Tagging" are incomplete)
main_complete <- main |> semi_join(sets_complete, by = "image_set_id")

cat("wildlife rows:", nrow(main), "| in finished sets:", nrow(main_complete), "\n")
```

## 1. Independent events

**Why:** one animal walking past a camera can trigger many photos. Counting photos overstates activity.
We count one **event** per animal visit: a new event starts when the same species at the same camera
has not been seen for more than `event_gap_min` minutes. The proposal says the threshold must be stated in the report.

```{r}
#| label: events
events <- main_complete |>
  mutate(n_ind = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(individual_count))) |>   # "VNA" becomes NA
  arrange(location, species_common_name, datetime) |>
  group_by(location, species_common_name) |>
  mutate(gap_min   = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins")),
         new_event = is.na(gap_min) | gap_min > event_gap_min,
         event_no  = cumsum(new_event)) |>
  group_by(location, species_common_name, event_no) |>
  summarise(event_start    = min(datetime),
            event_end      = max(datetime),
            n_images       = n(),
            max_individuals = if (all(is.na(n_ind))) NA_real_ else max(n_ind, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(event_id = row_number())

cat("rows:", nrow(main_complete), "-> independent events:", nrow(events), "\n")

events |> count(species_common_name, sort = TRUE) |> head(10)

write_csv(events, "outputs/events.csv")
```

## 2. QC checks

### 2a. Sampling effort (trap-days)

```{r}
#| label: effort
effort_by_set <- sets |>
  arrange(location, start) |>
  group_by(location) |>
  mutate(prev_max_end = lag(cummax(as.numeric(end)), default = -Inf),
         eff_start    = pmax(as.numeric(start), prev_max_end),
         eff_days     = pmax(as.numeric(end) - eff_start, 0) / 86400) |>
  ungroup()

effort <- effort_by_set |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(n_sets            = n(),
            n_sets_untagged   = sum(image_set_status != "Tagging Complete"),
            images_untagged   = sum(image_set_count_total[image_set_status != "Tagging Complete"]),
            first_image       = min(start),
            last_image        = max(end),
            trap_days_all     = sum(eff_days),
            trap_days_tagged  = sum(eff_days[image_set_status == "Tagging Complete"]),
            .groups = "drop")

effort |> arrange(trap_days_tagged)
```

### 2b. Gaps between deployments

Days with no data between one image set and the next at the same camera.

```{r}
#| label: gaps
set_gaps <- sets |>
  arrange(location, start) |>
  group_by(location) |>
  mutate(prev_end = lag(cummax(as.numeric(end))),
         gap_days = (as.numeric(start) - prev_end) / 86400) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(gap_days), gap_days > 7) |>
  select(location, set_start = start, gap_days)

set_gaps |> arrange(desc(gap_days))
```

### 2c. Timestamps


```{r}
#| label: timestamps
main_all |>
  summarise(missing_time   = sum(is.na(datetime)),
            before_project = sum(datetime < project_start, na.rm = TRUE),
            after_export   = sum(datetime > export_date + 1, na.rm = TRUE))

main_all |>
  left_join(select(sets, image_set_id, start, end), by = "image_set_id") |>
  summarise(outside_set_window = sum(datetime < start | datetime > end + 60, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### 2d. Identification quality per site

Share of animal tags that could not be identified to species (blank scientific name), the share of tags
flagged for review, and the share of blurred images.

```{r}
#| label: id_quality
images <- read.csv(report_file("image_report"))

id_quality <- main_all |>
  semi_join(sets_complete, by = "image_set_id") |>
  filter(!(species_common_name %in% c("NONE", "STAFF/SETUP", "Vehicle", "Human"))) |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(n_animal_tags = n(),
            unid_share    = mean(species_scientific_name == ""),
            review_share  = mean(tag_needs_review == "t"),
            .groups = "drop")

blur <- images |>
  group_by(location) |>
  summarise(blur_share = mean(image_is_blurred == "t"), .groups = "drop")

id_quality |> arrange(desc(unid_share)) |> head(10)
```

### 2e. One table per site

Combines effort, events, species richness and the QC flags. **Detections per 100 trap-days** lets cameras with
different run times be compared.

```{r}
#| label: site_summary
site_summary <- effort |>
  left_join(count(events, location, name = "n_events"), by = "location") |>
  left_join(main_complete |> group_by(location) |>
              summarise(species_richness = n_distinct(species_common_name)), by = "location") |>
  left_join(id_quality, by = "location") |>
  left_join(blur, by = "location") |>
  mutate(n_events = replace_na(n_events, 0),
         events_per_100_trap_days = if_else(trap_days_tagged > 0,
                                            n_events / trap_days_tagged * 100, NA_real_),
         flag_no_tagged_data = trap_days_tagged == 0,
         flag_low_effort     = trap_days_tagged > 0 & trap_days_tagged < min_trap_days,
         flag_high_unid      = !is.na(unid_share) & unid_share > max_unid_share)

site_summary |>
  select(location, trap_days_tagged, n_events, events_per_100_trap_days,
         species_richness, unid_share, starts_with("flag_")) |>
  arrange(location)

write_csv(site_summary, "outputs/qc_site_summary.csv")
```

## 3. Activity patterns

**How:** This uses `events` (not photos) and each event's start time. Only species with at least
`min_events_activity` events are used, because curves from a handful of events are not meaningful.

```{r}
#| label: activity_data
act <- events |>
  mutate(hour_dec = hour(event_start) + minute(event_start) / 60 + second(event_start) / 3600,
         time_rad = hour_dec / 24 * 2 * pi)      # the overlap package wants radians

species_ok <- act |> count(species_common_name) |> filter(n >= min_events_activity) |> pull(species_common_name)
act_ok <- act |> filter(species_common_name %in% species_ok)
cat("species with enough events:", length(species_ok), "\n")
```

Hour-of-day curves. Midnight and 24:00 are the same moment, so the data is copied one day before and after,
which keeps the curve from dropping at the edges.

```{r}
#| label: activity_plot
wrap <- bind_rows(act_ok,
                  act_ok |> mutate(hour_dec = hour_dec - 24),
                  act_ok |> mutate(hour_dec = hour_dec + 24))

ggplot(wrap, aes(hour_dec)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(density) * 3), fill = "grey70") +
  facet_wrap(~ species_common_name) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 24)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 6)) +
  labs(x = "Hour of day (camera clock)", y = "Relative activity") +
  theme_bw()
```

Pairwise overlap (coefficient of overlap, 0 = never active at the same time, 1 = identical activity pattern).
The `overlap` package suggests the `Dhat1` estimator when the smaller sample is small (roughly under 50)
and `Dhat4` for larger samples. Install once with `install.packages("overlap")`.

```{r}
#| label: activity_overlap
library(overlap)
library(suntools)

pairs <- combn(species_ok, 2, simplify = FALSE)

activity_overlap <- map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
  a <- act_ok$time_rad[act_ok$species_common_name == p[1]]
  b <- act_ok$time_rad[act_ok$species_common_name == p[2]]
  est_type <- if (min(length(a), length(b)) < 50) "Dhat1" else "Dhat4"
  tibble(species_a = p[1], species_b = p[2], n_a = length(a), n_b = length(b),
         estimator = est_type, overlap = unname(overlapEst(a, b, type = est_type)))
})

activity_overlap |> arrange(desc(overlap))
write_csv(activity_overlap, "outputs/activity_overlap.csv")

# One pair drawn as two curves (change the species names):
a <- act_ok$time_rad[act_ok$species_common_name == "Red Fox"]
b <- act_ok$time_rad[act_ok$species_common_name == "Common Raccoon"]
overlapPlot(a, b)
```


## 4. Anonymized outputs (no locations)

**What this means:** the public dashboard must not show real camera names or coordinates. The proposal says to use labels
like "Location 1". Names such as `morris_1` or `kaskey_1` give away the site, so the labels below are assigned in a random
but repeatable order. The code in sections 1 to 5 keeps the real names (internal use). Only the plots in this section
are public-safe.

The file `outputs/PRIVATE_site_key.csv` maps real names to labels. Do not commit or share it. A good habit is to
add `outputs/PRIVATE_*` to `.gitignore`.

A true map with points is a team and AUNI decision (for example a map of coarse grid cells), so this section
uses a site-by-species chart instead.

```{r}
#| label: anonymized
set.seed(2026)
site_key <- tibble(location = sample(sort(unique(locations$location)))) |>
  mutate(site_label = sprintf("Location %02d", row_number()))

write_csv(site_key, "outputs/PRIVATE_site_key.csv")

# events per 100 trap-days for each site and species (finished sites only)
public_tbl <- events |>
  count(location, species_common_name, name = "n_events") |>
  left_join(select(effort, location, trap_days_tagged), by = "location") |>
  filter(trap_days_tagged > 0) |>
  mutate(rate = n_events / trap_days_tagged * 100) |>
  left_join(site_key, by = "location")

top_species <- events |> count(species_common_name, sort = TRUE) |> head(8) |> pull(species_common_name)

public_tbl |>
  filter(species_common_name %in% top_species) |>
  ggplot(aes(species_common_name, site_label, fill = rate)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Events per\n100 trap-days") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
